description: This file defines the Transaction model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to add, delete, retrieve, and aggregate customer transaction records in the database.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Model class for customer transaction data, providing CRUD operations and summary queries.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new customer transaction record in the database.

methods.name: deleteTransactions
methods.description: Deletes transaction records for a specific customer, optionally filtered by order ID.

methods.name: deleteTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes all transaction records associated with a specific order ID where the amount is negative.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transaction records for a customer, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total count of transactions for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Returns the total count of transactions for a specific order.

methods.name: getTransactionTotal
methods.description: Calculates the sum total of all transaction amounts for a customer.
